'''Riots''' were a form of civil disorder characterized by mass vandalism, violence, or other crime. They generally occurred as a culmination of some sort of popular grievance or dissent, usually dealing with poor living conditions, oppression, taxation, conflicts between species, races or religions, et cetera.

Such law enforcement organizations as the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]], [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]], [[Scout Soldier]]s, or the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Security Police/Legends|Security Police]] were used to suppress rioters. They used a variety of non-lethal weapons and equipment, including the [[Stun baton/Legends|energy baton]], the [[R-88 Suppressor riot rifle/Legends|R-88 Suppressor riot rifle]], the [[Taser stave]], the [[Strikebreaker]] Riot Control Vehicle,<ref name="Corporate Sector Sourcebook">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> and [[Recon-PK series droid|rolo-droids]].

==Historical riots==
===Old Republic era===
*Rampant unemployment as a result of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] caused angry citizens to begin rioting all over [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], setting entire sections of skyline on fire.
*When the Republic attempted to quarantine [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] because of a [[Brainworm Rot]] outbreak, rioters razed the hospital and detainment center at [[Narmlé]].
*Political animosity between [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vaklu]] and [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Talia (Onderon)|Talia]] supporters on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] led to the outbreak of many riots.<ref name="TSL">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>
*Several [[Coruscant riots]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]:
**[[Coruscant riots (3680 BBY)]]
**[[Coruscant riots (3661 BBY)]]
**[[Coruscant riots (3653 BBY)]]

===Rise of the Empire era===
*Months of riots on [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]] that resulted in the deaths of four [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were caused by a food shortage.
*On [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]], [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] attempted to retrieve [[Bendix Fust]] in the midst of a prisoner riot.
*The [[Prospector's Riot]] occurred when estranged buyers attacked the crew of the ''[[Lucky Despot]]'' for faulty [[Mini-Huvicko/Yuzabi Dowser binary hydromech droid|M-HYD droids]].
*The Tertiary Ingo Riots occurred on the harsh world of [[Ingo/Legends|Ingo]], presumably as a result of adverse conditions on the planet.
*Enslaved [[Yuzzem]] on [[Ragna III]] were known to riot frequently against their [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] subjugators.

===Rebellion era===
*[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Jander Graffe]] instigated alien riots in the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector]] in order to provide cover for a new "security tax."
*A series of gang-rivalry riots broke out on [[Lenthalis]] shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].
*Following the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] victory at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and the death of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], riots and uprisings took place on a multitude of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-held worlds, as the news spread across the galaxy.<ref name="Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

===New Republic era===
*[[Drend Navett]] committed several acts of sabotage and instigated riots on several planets, among them a riot on [[Dordolum]].
*During the [[Caamas Document Crisis]], [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] was the subject of many anti-[[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] riots.<ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>
*[[Human League]] marches characteristically turned into riots.
*The [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] had a reputation of corruption, including initiating riots on [[Ampliquen]].
*The [[Corellian Crisis|First Corellian Insurrection]] was marked by a number of riots.

===Legacy era===
*The internment of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] spurned a [[Coruscant terrorist attacks and riots|number of riots]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]
